SELECT 
  wo.work_order AS 工单号,
  p.part_no AS 料号编码,
  p.part_name AS 料号名称,
  pd.stage_code AS 区段,
  pd.plan_type_code AS 计划类型,
  pd.schedule_start_date AS 预计开始时间,
  pd.schedule_end_date AS 预计结束时间,
  wr.process_name AS 工序名称,
  wr.node_id AS 节点ID,
  wr.next_node_id AS 下一节点ID,
  wr.start_flag AS 开始标志,
  wr.end_flag AS 结束标志
FROM t_pd_wo wo
LEFT JOIN t_bd_part p ON wo.part_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN t_pd_plan_detail pd ON wo.plan_detail_id = pd.id
LEFT JOIN t_pd_wo_route wr ON wo.work_order = wr.work_order
ORDER BY wo.work_order
LIMIT 500;
